assessment.nobel_worthiness: Targeted protein degradation converts ubiquitin-proteasome biochemistry into a general chemical modality: bifunctional PROTACs and molecular glues (thalidomide-class drugs acting through cereblon) re-direct E3 ligases to chosen proteins. Original concept, clear mechanism, and broad impact on drug discovery and on how cell protein turnover is studied.
assessment.attribution: Crews and Deshaies conceived and first demonstrated PROTACs (2001); Handa and colleagues identified cereblon as the thalidomide target, explaining glue degraders. Ciulli, Gray and others made major later advances, so a three-person split between PROTAC concept and glue mechanism is plausible but contestable.
assessment.maturity: Clinical degraders are now in late-stage trials, and mechanism is independently confirmed in many labs; the first approved PROTAC drug is still pending, so recognition is slightly early but well supported.
uncertainties: Whether PROTACs and molecular glues are best recognized as one discovery
Credit among Crews, Deshaies, Handa, Ciulli, Gray and Sakamoto
Clinical validation is still maturing; my recollection of trial status is unverified

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Ionizable lipid nanoparticles are the enabling chemistry for siRNA drugs and mRNA vaccines, with extraordinary real-world impact. The chemistry of pKa-tuned lipids, self-assembly and endosomal escape is a distinct molecular achievement, and the nucleic-acid delivery problem was the bottleneck for the field.
assessment.attribution: Cullis and Hope developed ionizable lipid and rapid-mixing formulation technology; Anderson and Langer contributed combinatorial lipidoid discovery; MacLachlan and Madden were key in the Vancouver work. The prize configuration is crowded and patent-entangled.
assessment.maturity: Mature: clinically proven at global scale, with the 2023 Medicine Prize already acknowledging the mRNA payload side, so a chemistry prize for the carrier is timely.
uncertainties: Crowded credit across Vancouver and Boston groups
Overlap with the 2023 Medicine recognition may lower priority for some members
Exact attribution of the first ionizable-lipid design is from my memory, not verified

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Pd-catalyzed C-N coupling is one of the most widely used bond-forming reactions in pharmaceutical synthesis, with ligand design giving broad scope under mild conditions. Impact is undisputed, though the field already received recognition through the 2010 cross-coupling prize.
assessment.attribution: Buchwald and Hartwig independently developed the general catalysts and ligands; Kosugi's tin-amide precedent is earlier but less general. A two-person prize is clean.
assessment.maturity: Fully mature with decades of industrial use; the 2010 Nobel for Pd cross-coupling may be seen as having covered the area.
uncertainties: Whether the 2010 prize is viewed as already covering this
Credit for the precursor work of Kosugi and Migita

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Massively parallel sequencing reduced the cost of reading DNA by orders of magnitude and transformed genetics, cancer genomics and DNA-damage and replication studies. The chemistry of reversible terminators and clonal amplification on surfaces is a genuine chemical invention.
assessment.attribution: Balasubramanian and Klenerman invented the Solexa sequencing-by-synthesis chemistry; Rothberg led pyrosequencing-based 454 and Ion Torrent platforms; Mayer, Ju and others also contributed. Three people can be justified but the allocation is contested.
assessment.maturity: Mature and transformative for two decades; the main question is whether it counts as chemistry rather than biology/medicine.
uncertainties: Chemistry vs. physiology/medicine fit
Fair split between Solexa chemistry and the 454 technology
Prior recognition of Sanger sequencing (1980) may shape perceived novelty

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Shokat's covalent targeting of the KRAS G12C mutant, using a cysteine-directed tethering strategy, broke the long-held view that KRAS is undruggable, and his chemical-genetic analog-sensitive kinase approach changed how kinase signaling is dissected. Highly original with direct cancer-therapy impact.
assessment.attribution: Shokat is the clear principal for the KRAS G12C covalent inhibitor concept; drug development by industry (sotorasib, adagrasib) built on it. A sole award is defensible, though the chemical genetics and KRAS parts are different discoveries.
assessment.maturity: Approved drugs confirm the concept, but long-term clinical durability and resistance are still evolving.
uncertainties: Whether to recognize KRAS only or combined with chemical genetics
Role of industry teams and other academic KRAS groups in credit
Resistance to KRAS inhibitors may temper perceived impact

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Nanopore sequencing reads single DNA/RNA molecules electrically in real time, giving long reads and direct detection of base modifications. It brings together molecular biophysics, protein engineering and analytical chemistry in a commercial platform.
assessment.attribution: Deamer and Branton proposed and pursued the concept; Kasianowicz showed polynucleotide translocation; Bayley engineered pore proteins; Akeson demonstrated enzyme-controlled ratcheting. Credit is very distributed, and limiting to three is difficult.
assessment.maturity: Mature technology in wide use, though accuracy and throughput advances still continue.
uncertainties: Hard to limit to three from five or more key contributors
Status of Bayley (possible deceased) is uncertain to me
Fit with chemistry versus biophysics

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Reversible m6A methylation established an epitranscriptomic layer of gene regulation, with writers, erasers and readers, which links RNA chemistry to development, cancer and metabolism. A conceptually important discovery, in line with nucleotide- and nucleic-acid-centred biology.
assessment.attribution: He identified FTO as an m6A demethylase and formulated the reversible concept; Jaffrey and Rechavi mapped m6A transcriptome-wide (2012); Jia, Yang and Meyer contributed. Allocation among mapping and mechanism is debated.
assessment.maturity: Strong independent confirmation of writers, erasers and readers, but some mapping methods and the functions of individual sites are still debated.
uncertainties: Controversy over mapping accuracy and FTO substrate specificity
Allocation between concept, mapping and enzymology
Chemistry versus medicine/biology fit

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Base editors chemically convert one DNA base into another without double-strand breaks, an elegant protein-engineering and nucleoside-chemistry solution that opened a precise route to correct point mutations. Its relevance to DNA repair and genome integrity is high for me.
assessment.attribution: Liu led the conceptual and engineering work, with Komor (cytosine base editor) and Gaudelli (adenine base editor, requiring evolved deaminase) as lead investigators. Liu alone could also be defended; the Nobel in 2020 for CRISPR may alter how the committee frames this.
assessment.maturity: Rapidly maturing, with first clinical results, but long-term safety and off-target data are still limited, so timing is somewhat early.
uncertainties: Early clinical data and off-target effects
Prior CRISPR prize (2020) may reduce the novelty seen
Whether base and prime editing should be recognized together
